about: Dragonflies laying their eggs by dipping the abdomen's tip to the water: every catalogue row that says so (AnimalDex docs/ark/signature-behaviours.json, uses clip:dragonfly_dip_oviposit or clip:tandem_dip_oviposit), with the species' own sentence. drawn: the scene gives it the recipe dip_lay (the female alone); held: why not. Built by scripts/ark-egg-dip.mts.

species.name: Broad-bodied Chaser
species.behaviour: female hovers and flicks her abdomen tip into the water to lay while the male guards
species.quote: The female then lays alone, hovering and flicking the tip of her abdomen into the water over submerged plants while the male guards nearby.
species.line: {aAnimal} is hovering and flicking her abdomen tip into the water to lay

species.name: Common Darter
species.behaviour: pairs lay in tandem, male holding the female while she dips her abdomen into shallow water
species.quote: Pairs lay eggs in tandem, the male holding the female behind the head while she dips her abdomen into shallow water.
species.line: {animals} are laying in tandem, the female dipping her abdomen into shallow water
species.held: a pair in tandem is not drawn yet

species.name: Common Flangetail
species.behaviour: female flies low tapping her abdomen tip on open water to release eggs
species.quote: Females lay eggs by flying low and tapping the abdomen tip on open water, releasing eggs that sink to the bottom.
species.line: {aAnimal} is flying low and tapping her abdomen tip on open water to release eggs

species.name: Red-veined Darter
species.behaviour: pairs fly in tandem while the female taps eggs onto open water
species.quote: Pairs fly in tandem, the male holding the female, while she taps her abdomen on open water and releases eggs.
species.line: {animals} are flying in tandem as the female taps her abdomen on open water
species.held: a pair in tandem is not drawn yet

species.name: Ruddy Darter
species.behaviour: pairs in tandem flick eggs over damp mud and shallow margins
species.quote: Pairs lay eggs in tandem, the female flicking them over damp mud, dry vegetation or shallow water at the margin.
species.line: {animals} are laying in tandem, the female flicking eggs over the damp margin
species.held: a pair in tandem is not drawn yet

species.name: Scarlet Skimmer
species.behaviour: female taps her abdomen on the water to wash off eggs with the male hovering close
species.quote: the female flies low over open water and taps the tip of her abdomen on the surface to wash off eggs, often with the male hovering close by
species.line: {aAnimal} is tapping her abdomen on the water to wash off eggs, the male close by

species.name: Wandering Glider
species.behaviour: female taps eggs into temporary pools in flight, spreading the clutch across several
species.quote: Eggs are dropped straight into temporary pools with the female tapping the water surface in flight, spreading a clutch across several pools rather than committing it all to one that might dry.
species.line: {aAnimal} is tapping the water in flight, dropping eggs into a temporary pool
species.lineHeld: its sentence names a temporary rain pool; the scene's water is standing
